findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_design_md, lint_design_md, get_feedback_reply · Private data: extract_design_md, lint_design_md, diff_design_md · Public sink: extract_design_md, submit_feedback · Destructive: extract_design_md, diff_design_md, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_design_md, lint_design_md, get_feedback_reply · Private data: extract_design_md, lint_design_md, diff_design_md · Public sink: extract_design_md, submit_feedback · Destructive: extract_design_md, diff_design_md, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
